episode_title: Why Your Team Doesn't Care About Your $50 Million Goal

real_qa.q: What is the appropriate marketing mix between brand and performance marketing according to recent studies?
real_qa.r: According to research by Bain & Company called 'The Long and Short of It', the appropriate mix is approximately 62% brand marketing and 38% performance or call-to-action marketing. Many businesses, especially marketers, focus 100% on call-to-action performance marketing and forget about building brand awareness, which allows the company to rent-free live in potential customers' minds so when they need the service, they think of you first.
real_qa.requete: Bain Company long short brand performance marketing 62 38

real_qa.q: How did Eric Thomas start Rival Digital after meeting Array Digital founders?
real_qa.r: Eric Thomas met Kevin Daisy and Eric J. Olson at a Starbucks meeting where they discussed a referral partnership. Array Digital had an existing HVAC client looking for digital marketing help but couldn't serve them due to exclusivity agreements. They proposed spinning up a new agency with Eric as president to run Rival Digital, starting with that client and providing him a lateral salary swap. Eric quit his job on Wednesday, three days after the Monday meeting.
real_qa.requete: Eric Thomas Rival Digital started Array Digital Kevin Daisy Eric Olson

real_qa.q: What conference booth strategy did Rival Digital use instead of traditional lead-capture tactics?
real_qa.r: Instead of standard booth tactics like tablecloths, pens, candy, and product demos, Rival Digital gave out items hungover conference attendees actually needed like Red Bull, Zen, Tylenol, water, and Liquid IV. They geofenced the Louisville Expo Hall and Expo Center with an ad saying 'hang over here with us after the bourbon distillery tour' with no pushy call-to-action, allowing attendees to remember them as the helpful brand rather than aggressive salespeople.
real_qa.requete: conference booth strategy Tylenol Red Bull geofencing

real_qa.q: How much does a typical 10x10 booth space cost at industry conferences?
real_qa.r: The going rate for booth space is approximately $100 per square foot, meaning a minimum 10x10 booth would cost between $5,000 to $6,000, not including additional costs for electricity, Wi-Fi, and floor padding. Eric Thomas noted that after shipping booth materials there and back home because attendees wouldn't take promotional items, the ROI was difficult to track, shifting their focus to branding and visibility instead.

real_qa.q: What service lines did Rival Digital expand from HVAC to include in home services?
real_qa.r: Rival Digital expanded from HVAC-only to include plumbing, electrical, and garage door companies. Eric Thomas explained that many HVAC companies already install water heaters without needing plumbing licenses since they work gas lines similar to furnaces and condensers. Water heaters became a gateway to plumbing services because homeowners would then ask them to fix toilets and faucets. Larger companies they targeted already offered multiple service lines with bigger marketing budgets.
real_qa.requete: Rival Digital home services HVAC plumbing electrical garage door

guest.bio_context: Eric Thomas started Rival Digital approximately seven years ago after meeting Kevin Daisy and Eric J. Olson of Array Digital at a Starbucks near Lindenhurst Mall. He quit his job on a Wednesday following a Monday meeting where they proposed spinning up a new agency to serve an HVAC company client, offering him a lateral salary swap. Rival Digital, initially focused on HVAC marketing, has since expanded to home services including plumbing, electrical, and garage door companies through strategic partnerships with coaching organizations for contractors.
